dominion.of.canada.unoffical: Pavel Unoffical reached S-C9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
imerv2: On Day 8 Isidor "Saint" Imerv took a post at R-S17 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hums hymns when frightened, and the men liked him for it.
Casimir Nile and Isidor "Saint" Imerv argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
joseph_austin15_: Emil "Spark" Austin arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
oliversheppard1: Pavel "Tin" Oliversheppa found a place in T-S7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
